$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$src='C:\Users\Xxkan\actions-runner-heaven\_work\mhw-mods\mhw-mods'
$sha='d080d746356f6e3725f5f6d1ed5eba5c204cb69f'
git -C $src fetch origin $sha
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'exact SHA fetch failed' }
$wt="C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\work\gui-main-$($sha.Substring(0,8))"
if(Test-Path $wt){ git -C $src worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $wt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
git -C $src worktree add --detach $wt $sha
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'worktree add failed' }
Push-Location $wt
$env:DOTNET_NOLOGO='1'; $env:DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1'
dotnet restore .\src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'restore failed' }
dotnet build .\src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj -c Release --no-restore -warnaserror -p:NuGetAudit=false
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'app build failed' }
$bin=Join-Path $wt 'src\MhwModManager.App\bin\Release\net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0'
Get-ChildItem $bin | Select-Object Name,Length,FullName | Format-Table -AutoSize
Write-Output "GUI_WORKTREE=$wt"
Write-Output "GUI_BIN=$bin"
Write-Output "GUI_SHA=$sha"
Pop-Location
